species.real: The clurichaun was said to go riding on sheep or sheepdogs by moonlight, and a house that treated him well would find its wine never went sour.
species.name: Cluricaun

dex.text: A tiny cobbler with quick hands and quicker excuses. Whatever has gone missing from the cellar, it definitely was not him, and he has a shoe to finish.
dex.fact: In Irish folklore the clurichaun is a solitary fairy who haunts cellars, and he is often called a cousin of the leprechaun, the fairy shoemaker.
